prompts.prompt: Create ONE rear three-quarter battle-standing sprite for this exact dwarf cannon engineer, using the supplied lobby portrait as character identity and style reference. Full entire body and full cannon, front of body turned AWAY from viewer facing towards the upper-right enemy battlefield, camera viewing his back at a slight elevated angle. Keep the reddish braided beard only visible at side, brass goggles, gold plated broad shoulders, mustard coat, charcoal apron, stocky dwarf proportions, leather belt and armored boots, and the SAME large dark-iron cannon with brass rings. Both feet planted, offset stance, hands holding cannon ready aimed up-right, entire weapon in frame. Clear hand-drawn dark outlines, crisp angular cel shading and bold readable costume shapes exactly like reference. Genuine transparent alpha background with NO floor, gradient, glow, cast shadow, frame, text, effects or particles. No animation, no alternate views, one complete character only. Leave a generous 8 percent empty margin on ALL four sides; head, cape, feet, barrel and muzzle must not touch edges. Portrait 2:3 canvas.

True transparent background, NO floor, glow cloud, gradients, cast shadow, text, labels, frame, particles or scenery. No animation, no sheet, no extra view or character.
